Text: IF the POS cannot read the member QR code, THEN the POS shall let the cashier enter the member number manually.
Rationale: Cashiers need a fallback when the app screen is too dark to scan.

Text: The loyalty service shall expire posted points 12 months after posting.
Rationale: Limits the points liability on the balance sheet (SH-03).

Text: The loyalty service shall expire posted points 18 months after posting.
Rationale: Occasional shoppers lose points before they reach the redemption minimum.
